summary.text: Jonathan Karlen is a Democratic state representative from Montana House District 98 who has served in the Montana House since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A wildlife research fellow by profession, he serves on committees including House Rules, Natural Resources and Fish, Wildlife and Parks.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Karlen earned a bachelor's degree in wildlife biology and climate change studies from the University of Montana in 2021 and a master's degree in public administration from the same university in 2022.
His career experience includes working as a wildlife research fellow, and he joined the City of Missoula's Climate and Energy board in 2021.

Karlen has served in the Montana House since 2023, and in the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the House Rules Committee and a member of the Legislative Administration, Natural Resources, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, Taxation, and Business and Labor committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Bryan Muzzana in the general election.
